name: Masala Roasted Carrot, Lentil & Feta Tacos with Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse lentils, then divide between two baking sheet pans.
Add carrots to the baking sheets with the lentils. Drizzle with oil and season with spices; stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp garam masala
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until carrots and lentils are warmed through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ English cucumbers
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the limes into a medium bowl. Cut remaining limes into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers. Add to the bowl.
Medium dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl along with salt and coriander, then stir to combine the salad. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with warm lentil-carrot mixture and feta. Serve with salad on the side and lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
